items.gu: પોલીસ અધિકારીએ મને ડ્રાઇવિંગ લાઇસન્સ બતાવવા કહ્યું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.26). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 提示 means taking something out (or bringing it along) and showing it. (added, not in book) 提示 and 指示 share 示 (show) — 指示する means to instruct, which the officer does, not the driver.

items.q: 始める前に、今日の会議の内容の（ ）をお話ししておきます。
items.qr: Hajimeru mae ni, kyou no kaigi no naiyou no (___) o ohanashi shite okimasu.
items.en: Before we start, let me give you an outline of what today's meeting will cover.
items.hi: शुरू करने से पहले मैं आज की बैठक की रूपरेखा बता देता हूँ।
items.gu: શરૂ કરતા પહેલાં હું આજની બેઠકની રૂપરેખા જણાવી દઉં.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 概要 (gaiyou) has the same meaning.

items.q: 引っ越しの業者に、引っ越し料金の（ ）を出してもらった。
items.qr: Hikkoshi no gyousha ni, hikkoshi ryoukin no (___) o dashite moratta.
items.en: I had the moving company give me an estimate of the moving charges.
items.hi: मैंने सामान शिफ़्ट करने वाली कंपनी से ख़र्च का अनुमान (कोटेशन) बनवाया।
items.gu: મેં ઘરવખરી ખસેડનારી કંપની પાસેથી ખર્ચનો અંદાજ (ક્વોટેશન) મંગાવ્યો.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): It means calculating charges or costs in advance; 予算 (budget) is roughly similar. (added, not in book) 見込み shares 見 and also looks ahead, but it is a forecast (合格の見込み), not a price quote.

items.q: 自分の意見を一方的に言うだけでは、相手の（ ）を買うだけだ。
items.qr: Jibun no iken o ippouteki ni iu dake de wa, aite no (___) o kau dake da.
items.en: If you only push your own opinion one-sidedly, you will just turn the other person against you.
items.hi: सिर्फ़ एकतरफ़ा अपनी राय थोपने से सामने वाले की नाराज़गी ही मोल लोगे।
items.gu: ફક્ત એકતરફી પોતાનો મત કહેવાથી સામેવાળાની નારાજગી જ વહોરી લેશો.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): Learn the phrase 反感を買う (to provoke antipathy). (added, not in book) 〜を買う here means "bring on yourself"; 同情 normally goes with 同情する / 同情を集める.

items.q: 老後は、仕事をしないで（ ）のある生活を送りたいと思っている。
items.qr: Rougo wa, shigoto o shinaide (___) no aru seikatsu o okuritai to omotte iru.
items.en: In my old age I want to stop working and live a relaxed life with time to spare.
items.hi: बुढ़ापे में मैं काम छोड़कर आराम और फ़ुर्सत वाली ज़िंदगी जीना चाहता हूँ।
items.gu: ઘડપણમાં હું કામ છોડીને નિરાંતવાળું જીવન જીવવા માગું છું.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 余裕 (yoyuu) has the same meaning.

items.q: 新しい製品の開発のためには、社員の（ ）を重視しています。
items.qr: Atarashii seihin no kaihatsu no tame ni wa, shain no (___) o juushi shite imasu.
items.en: To develop new products, we put great weight on our employees' ideas.
items.hi: नए उत्पाद बनाने के लिए हम कर्मचारियों के विचारों (आइडिया) को महत्व देते हैं।
items.gu: નવાં ઉત્પાદનો વિકસાવવા માટે અમે કર્મચારીઓના વિચારો (આઇડિયા)ને મહત્વ આપીએ છીએ.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): It means 考え, 発想 (thinking, ideas).

items.q: 今まで集めた（ ）を一般の人に公開するために、美術館を造った。
items.qr: Ima made atsumeta (___) o ippan no hito ni koukai suru tame ni, bijutsukan o tsukutta.
items.en: A museum was built to open the collection gathered so far to the public.
items.hi: अब तक इकट्ठा किए गए संग्रह को आम लोगों को दिखाने के लिए संग्रहालय बनाया गया।
items.gu: અત્યાર સુધી ભેગો કરેલો સંગ્રહ લોકોને બતાવવા સંગ્રહાલય બનાવાયું.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): コレクション means "things that have been collected".

items.q: 後から見てもわかるように、ペンで（ ）しておいた。
items.qr: Ato kara mite mo wakaru you ni, pen de (___) shite oita.
items.en: I marked it with a pen so that I would still understand it when I looked later.
items.hi: बाद में देखने पर भी समझ आए, इसलिए मैंने पेन से निशान लगा दिया।
items.gu: પછી જોઉં ત્યારે પણ સમજાય તે માટે મેં પેનથી નિશાન કરી રાખ્યું.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): マークする here means しるしをつける (to put a mark on). (added, not in book) ラベル is a stuck-on tag (ラベルを貼る); ラベルする is not used.

items.q: 友達の家の花びんを割ってしまったので、（ ）しようと思っている。
items.qr: Tomodachi no ie no kabin o watte shimatta node, (___) shiyou to omotte iru.
items.en: I broke a vase at my friend's house, so I intend to pay for it.
items.hi: मैंने दोस्त के घर का फूलदान तोड़ दिया, इसलिए उसकी भरपाई करने की सोच रहा हूँ।
items.gu: મેં મિત્રના ઘરનું ફૂલદાન તોડી નાખ્યું, તેથી તેની ભરપાઈ કરવાનું વિચારું છું.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): It means paying for the broken vase or buying the same one again. (added, not in book) 返済 is paying back borrowed money (ローンの返済); 弁償 is paying for damage you caused.

items.q: 緊張のあまり、スピーチの内容を（ ）してしまった。
items.qr: Kinchou no amari, supiichi no naiyou o (___) shite shimatta.
items.en: I was so nervous that what I meant to say in my speech went right out of my head.
items.hi: इतना घबरा गया कि भाषण में क्या कहना था, बिलकुल भूल गया।
items.gu: એટલો ગભરાઈ ગયો કે ભાષણમાં શું બોલવાનું હતું તે સાવ ભૂલી ગયો.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): Written 度忘れ; it means forgetting something and being unable to recall it. (added, not in book) だいなし takes 〜をだいなしにする (ruin something), not 〜をだいなしする.

items.q: 地球は約24時間で1回（ ）する。
items.qr: Chikyuu wa yaku nijuuyo jikan de ikkai (___) suru.
items.en: The earth rotates once in about 24 hours.
items.hi: पृथ्वी लगभग 24 घंटे में एक बार अपनी धुरी पर घूमती है।
items.gu: પૃથ્વી લગભગ 24 કલાકમાં એક વાર પોતાની ધરી પર ફરે છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.28). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): Turning by itself is called 自転; it is often used for celestial bodies. (added, not in book) Its partner is 公転 (kouten), revolving around the sun. All four options share 転 — the "same kanji" trap.

items.q: 犬は、人間が感じることのできない（ ）においをかぐことができる。
items.qr: Inu wa, ningen ga kanjiru koto no dekinai (___) nioi o kagu koto ga dekiru.
items.en: Dogs can pick up faint smells that humans cannot sense.
items.hi: कुत्ते वह हल्की-सी गंध सूँघ सकते हैं जिसे इंसान महसूस नहीं कर पाते।
items.gu: કૂતરાં એવી આછી ગંધ સૂંઘી શકે છે જે માણસ અનુભવી શકતો નથી.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): かすかな means "very small, weak"; here わずかな would also work.
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: このアパートは、日当たりが（ ）で、駅からも近いです。
items.qr: Kono apaato wa, hiatari ga (___) de, eki kara mo chikai desu.
items.en: This apartment gets plenty of sunlight and is close to the station too.
items.hi: इस अपार्टमेंट में धूप अच्छी आती है और यह स्टेशन के भी पास है।
items.gu: આ અપાર્ટમેન્ટમાં તડકો સારો આવે છે અને તે સ્ટેશનથી પણ નજીક છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 日当たりが良好 means 日当たりがよい (gets good sunlight). (added, not in book) 新鮮 is a な-adjective too, but it is for food, air or impressions, not sunlight.
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: このマンションなら、サラリーマンでも（ ）価格で購入できる。
items.qr: Kono manshon nara, sarariiman demo (___) kakaku de kounyuu dekiru.
items.en: With this condominium, even an ordinary salaried worker can buy at an affordable price.
items.hi: इस फ़्लैट को तो एक आम नौकरीपेशा व्यक्ति भी वाजिब दाम में खरीद सकता है।
items.gu: આ ફ્લેટ તો સામાન્ય નોકરિયાત પણ પોસાય તેવી કિંમતે ખરીદી શકે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): てごろな means "just right (for doing something)".
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: 犯人逮捕の（ ）てがかりが見つからないまま、1カ月が過ぎてしまった。
items.qr: Hannin taiho no (___) tegakari ga mitsukaranai mama, ikkagetsu ga sugite shimatta.
items.en: A month has gone by without any strong lead toward arresting the culprit.
items.hi: अपराधी को पकड़ने का कोई ठोस सुराग़ मिले बिना एक महीना बीत गया।
items.gu: ગુનેગારને પકડવા માટે કોઈ મજબૂત કડી મળ્યા વિના એક મહિનો વીતી ગયો.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 有力な expresses having strong power to make something happen (here: to lead to an arrest).
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: あれこれ言われる前に自分から社長の職を辞めたのは（ ）判断だった。
items.qr: Arekore iwareru mae ni jibun kara shachou no shoku o yameta no wa (___) handan datta.
items.en: Stepping down as president on his own before people started saying things was a wise decision.
items.hi: लोगों की बातें शुरू होने से पहले ही खुद अध्यक्ष पद छोड़ देना समझदारी भरा फ़ैसला था।
items.gu: લોકો કંઈ કહે તે પહેલાં જાતે જ પ્રમુખપદ છોડી દેવું એ ડહાપણભર્યો નિર્ણય હતો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 賢明な means "wise and appropriate"; it is mostly used as 賢明な判断 (decision) or 賢明な選択 (choice).
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: （ ）リズムに乗って、楽しく踊りましょう。
items.qr: (___) rizumu ni notte, tanoshiku odorimashou.
items.en: Let's move to the light, lively rhythm and dance and have fun.
items.hi: हल्की-फुल्की, उछलती लय पर मज़े से नाचें।
items.gu: હળવી, ઉમંગભરી લય પર મજાથી નાચીએ.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 軽快な describes something that makes you feel pleasantly light. It can also describe light, quick-looking movements. (added, not in book) All four share 軽 — the "same kanji" trap. 軽率な is negative (thoughtless), 気軽な/手軽な are about ease.
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: 一つ問題が解決したと思ったら、（ ）問題が発生した。
items.qr: Hitotsu mondai ga kaiketsu shita to omottara, (___) mondai ga hassei shita.
items.en: Just when I thought one problem had been solved, a new one came up.
items.hi: जैसे ही लगा कि एक समस्या सुलझ गई, एक नई समस्या खड़ी हो गई।
items.gu: એક સમસ્યા ઉકલી એવું લાગ્યું ત્યાં જ નવી સમસ્યા ઊભી થઈ.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): Written 新たな; it means the same as 新しい.
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: 大きな失敗をすると、だれでも（ ）気持ちになるものだ。
items.qr: Ookina shippai o suru to, dare demo (___) kimochi ni naru mono da.
items.en: When you make a big mistake, anyone ends up feeling gloomy.
items.hi: बड़ी ग़लती करने पर कोई भी उदास हो ही जाता है।
items.gu: મોટી ભૂલ થાય ત્યારે કોઈ પણ ઉદાસ થઈ જ જાય છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): You can solve it once you notice that the person who fails and the person who feels ゆううつ are the same person. (added, not in book) めんどうな describes a task or a person you have to deal with, not the mood you are left in.
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: 彼女はモデルをしているだけあって、いつも（ ）服を着ている。
items.qr: Kanojo wa moderu o shite iru dake atte, itsumo (___) fuku o kite iru.
items.en: As you would expect of a model, she always wears chic clothes.
items.hi: मॉडल होने के नाते वह हमेशा सलीकेदार, स्टाइलिश कपड़े पहनती है।
items.gu: મૉડલ હોવાને લીધે તે હંમેશાં શાલીન, સ્ટાઇલિશ કપડાં પહેરે છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): It shows good taste and elegance (趣味がよく上品な様子).
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: あなたの発想は、ほかの人にはないとても（ ）ものですね。
items.qr: Anata no hassou wa, hoka no hito ni wa nai totemo (___) mono desu ne.
items.en: Your way of thinking is really unique — nobody else has ideas like that.
items.hi: तुम्हारी सोच बहुत अनोखी है, जो किसी और में नहीं।
items.gu: તમારી વિચારસરણી ખૂબ અનોખી છે, જે બીજા કોઈમાં નથી.

opts.en: (トーン "tone" is a noun; not used with な)
(ニュアンス "nuance" is a noun; not used with な)
(ユーモア "humour" is a noun; ユーモアのある is correct)
opts.hi: (संज्ञा है; ユーモアのある सही है)
opts.gu: (નામ છે; ユーモアのある સાચું છે)

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.32). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): ほかの人にはない (that others don't have) is the hint.
items.unit: 文脈規定 ナ形容詞

items.q: 一人暮らしをしている子どものことを案じる親は多いものだ。
items.qr: Hitorigurashi o shite iru kodomo no koto o anjiru oya wa ooi mono da.
items.en: Many parents worry about their children who live on their own.
items.hi: अकेले रहने वाले अपने बच्चों की चिंता करने वाले माता-पिता बहुत होते हैं।
items.gu: એકલાં રહેતાં પોતાનાં બાળકોની ચિંતા કરનારાં માતા-પિતા ઘણાં હોય છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.36). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 案じる means 心配する (to worry), and it also has the meaning 考える (to think something out). Other options (added, not in book): none of 1–3 carries "worry": 意見する is telling someone off, 相談する is asking for advice, 遠慮する is holding back.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞①

items.q: 老人をもっといたわるべきだ。
items.qr: Roujin o motto itawaru beki da.
items.en: We should treat the elderly with more care.
items.hi: हमें बुज़ुर्गों का और अधिक ख़्याल रखना चाहिए।
items.gu: આપણે વૃદ્ધોની વધુ કાળજી રાખવી જોઈએ.

opts.hi: किसी बात पर अड़े रहना, बारीकी पर ज़ोर देना

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.36). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): いたわる means 大事にする (to treat with care) and also やさしく接する (to treat gently). Other options (added, not in book): やしなう (養う) is supporting someone financially (家族を養う) — close, but it has no "gentle care" nuance. こだわる only sounds a little like いたわる.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞①

items.q: 自分の気持ちをすべて彼に打ち明けた。
items.qr: Jibun no kimochi o subete kare ni uchiaketa.
items.en: I told him everything I felt.
items.hi: मैंने अपने दिल की सारी बात उसे खुलकर बता दी।
items.gu: મેં મારા મનની બધી વાત તેને ખુલ્લા દિલે કહી દીધી.

opts.hi: दिल की बात कह दी, स्वीकार किया

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.36). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): for telling someone a secret or what you had in your heart without hiding it, 告白する means almost the same. Other options (added, not in book): 説明する is explaining facts or reasons — it lacks the "revealing something hidden" nuance of 打ち明ける.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞①

items.q: 忙しくて、返事を書くのを怠っていました。
items.qr: Isogashikute, henji o kaku no o okotatte imashita.
items.en: I was busy and neglected to write a reply.
items.hi: व्यस्त होने के कारण मैंने जवाब लिखने में लापरवाही की।
items.gu: વ્યસ્ત હોવાથી મેં જવાબ લખવામાં બેદરકારી કરી.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.36). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 怠る has the meaning of 怠ける (namakeru), written with the same kanji 怠. さぼる (made from a foreign word; also written サボる) means the same. Other options (added, not in book): あせる and あわてる are about being rushed or flustered, not about not doing something; とぼける is pretending not to know.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞①

items.q: 秋の京都をおとずれる人はたくさんいる。
items.qr: Aki no Kyouto o otozureru hito wa takusan iru.
items.en: Many people visit Kyoto in autumn.
items.hi: पतझड़ में क्योटो घूमने आने वाले लोग बहुत हैं।
items.gu: પાનખરમાં ક્યોટોની મુલાકાત લેનારા લોકો ઘણા છે.

opts.en: to be based on, take into account

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.36). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 訪れる has the meaning of 訪ねる, written with the same kanji 訪. Other options (added, not in book): たずねる is also 尋ねる (to ask), but here it is 訪ねる. ひきいる (率いる) and ふまえる (踏まえる) are unrelated.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞①

items.q: 体力は、年齢とともに衰えていくものだ。
items.qr: Tairyoku wa, nenrei to tomo ni otoroete iku mono da.
items.en: Physical strength naturally declines with age.
items.hi: उम्र के साथ शारीरिक ताक़त घटती ही जाती है।
items.gu: ઉંમર સાથે શારીરિક શક્તિ ઘટતી જ જાય છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.36). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): there is also the word 衰弱 (suijaku, weakening), which joins 衰 with the 弱 of 弱くなる. Other options (added, not in book): 薄くなる fits hair or colour (髪が薄くなる), not 体力.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞①

items.q: 我が社の社長は仕事の雰囲気を直接見たくて、現場に赴くことが多いそうだ。
items.qr: Waga sha no shachou wa shigoto no fun'iki o chokusetsu mitakute, genba ni omomuku koto ga ooi sou da.
items.en: I hear our company president often goes to the work sites because he wants to see the atmosphere for himself.
items.hi: सुना है कि हमारी कंपनी के अध्यक्ष काम का माहौल ख़ुद देखने के लिए अक्सर कार्यस्थल पर जाते हैं।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે અમારી કંપનીના પ્રમુખ કામનું વાતાવરણ જાતે જોવા માટે ઘણી વાર કાર્યસ્થળે જાય છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.36). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): a word using 赴 is 赴任 (funin), meaning "going to one's new post". Other options (added, not in book): 任せる is a trap built on the 任 of 赴任 — the compound means "go to a post", not "entrust".
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞①

items.q: タバコを吸うことは健康を害する行為である。
items.qr: Tabako o suu koto wa kenkou o gai suru koui de aru.
items.en: Smoking is an act that harms your health.
items.hi: सिगरेट पीना स्वास्थ्य को नुक़सान पहुँचाने वाला काम है।
items.gu: સિગારેટ પીવી એ આરોગ્યને નુકસાન પહોંચાડતું કૃત્ય છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.36). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): there is also the word 損害 (songai, damage), which joins the 損 of 損なう with 害. 悪くする also means the same.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞①

items.q: 自分を成長させるには、自分をかえりみる時間を持つことが大事だ。
items.qr: Jibun o seichou saseru ni wa, jibun o kaerimiru jikan o motsu koto ga daiji da.
items.en: To grow as a person, it is important to have time to reflect on yourself.
items.hi: ख़ुद को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए अपने बारे में आत्मचिंतन करने का समय रखना ज़रूरी है।
items.gu: પોતાનો વિકાસ કરવા માટે આત્મચિંતન કરવાનો સમય રાખવો જરૂરી છે.

opts.hi: आत्मचिंतन करना, अपनी ग़लती पर विचार करना

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.38). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): かえりみる can be written 省みる or 顧みる. Written 省みる it means the same as 反省する; written 顧みる it means the same as (昔のことを)振り返る, "look back on the past". Other options (added, not in book): with 自分を and 成長, the 省みる meaning (反省) is the one that fits.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞②

items.q: 今月は結婚式や飲み会が多く、出費がかさむ。
items.qr: Kongetsu wa kekkonshiki ya nomikai ga ooku, shuppi ga kasamu.
items.en: This month there are lots of weddings and drinking parties, so my expenses are piling up.
items.hi: इस महीने शादियाँ और पार्टियाँ बहुत हैं, इसलिए ख़र्च बढ़ता जा रहा है।
items.gu: આ મહિને લગ્ન અને પાર્ટીઓ ઘણી છે, એટલે ખર્ચ વધતો જાય છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.38). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): かさむ is used when a quantity or an amount of money increases. Other options (added, not in book): 積もる is for things physically piling up (雪が積もる) — tempting, but it is not used with 出費.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞②

items.q: あきらめずに努力し続ければ、必ず夢はかなうものだ。
items.qr: Akiramezu ni doryoku shitsuzukereba, kanarazu yume wa kanau mono da.
items.en: If you keep working hard without giving up, your dream will surely come true.
items.hi: अगर हार माने बिना मेहनत करते रहो, तो सपना ज़रूर पूरा होता है।
items.gu: હાર માન્યા વગર મહેનત કરતા રહો તો સપનું ચોક્કસ સાકાર થાય છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.38). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): かなう means that a dream or wish is realised. It also has the meaning "to match an ideal or condition" (条件にかなう).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞②

items.q: メーカー各社は、次世代の車をきそって開発している。
items.qr: Meekaa kakusha wa, jisedai no kuruma o kisotte kaihatsu shite iru.
items.en: Every manufacturer is competing to develop next-generation cars.
items.hi: हर निर्माता कंपनी होड़ लगाकर अगली पीढ़ी की कारें विकसित कर रही है।
items.gu: દરેક ઉત્પાદક કંપની હરીફાઈ કરીને આગામી પેઢીની કાર વિકસાવી રહી છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.38). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): in kanji it is written 競って, so 競争する is the closest meaning.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞②

items.q: ノートパソコンが1万円だなんて、これまでの常識を覆す価格だね。
items.qr: Nooto pasokon ga ichiman-en da nante, kore made no joushiki o kutsugaesu kakaku da ne.
items.en: A laptop for 10,000 yen? That price overturns everything we took for granted.
items.hi: लैपटॉप सिर्फ़ 10,000 येन में? यह तो अब तक की आम धारणा को उलट देने वाली क़ीमत है।
items.gu: લૅપટૉપ ફક્ત 10,000 યેનમાં? આ તો અત્યાર સુધીની સામાન્ય માન્યતાને ઉલટાવી દેતી કિંમત છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.38). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): read くつがえす. It means the same as ひっくりかえす, and is also used for "greatly changing a way of thinking that had been held to be correct".
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞②

items.q: 「品がない」という理由で、テレビの娯楽番組をけなす人は多い。
items.qr: "Hin ga nai" to iu riyuu de, terebi no goraku bangumi o kenasu hito wa ooi.
items.en: Many people run down TV entertainment shows as "tasteless".
items.hi: बहुत से लोग "भद्दे हैं" कहकर टीवी के मनोरंजन कार्यक्रमों की बुराई करते हैं।
items.gu: ઘણા લોકો "અસભ્ય છે" કહીને ટીવીના મનોરંજન કાર્યક્રમોની નિંદા કરે છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.38). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): けなす means almost the same as 悪く言う. Its opposite is ほめる (to praise). Other options (added, not in book): やっつける is beating an opponent, and 打ち消す is denying a statement — neither means criticising.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞②

items.q: わがままばかり言っていると、人間関係はこじれてしまうものだ。
items.qr: Wagamama bakari itte iru to, ningen kankei wa kojirete shimau mono da.
items.en: If you keep being selfish, your relationships will turn sour.
items.hi: अगर हमेशा मनमानी करते रहो, तो रिश्ते बिगड़ ही जाते हैं।
items.gu: જો હંમેશાં મનમાની કરતા રહો, તો સંબંધો બગડી જ જાય છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.38). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): こじれる means that a relationship or discussion gets tangled and stops going well, so here 悪化する is the closest meaning.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞②

items.q: 彼は料理教室に行って以来、料理にこっている。
items.qr: Kare wa ryouri kyoushitsu ni itte irai, ryouri ni kotte iru.
items.en: Ever since he went to a cooking class, he's been really into cooking.
items.hi: कुकिंग क्लास जाने के बाद से वह खाना बनाने में पूरी तरह मग्न है।
items.gu: રસોઈના વર્ગમાં ગયા પછી તે રસોઈમાં તલ્લીન થઈ ગયો છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.38). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): in the form 〜にこる it means 〜に夢中になる (to be absorbed in ~). Other options (added, not in book): こる (凝る) also means "to get stiff" (肩がこる) — a different use; しびれる (go numb) is a trap linked to that body meaning.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞②

items.q: 最近、何をやってもしくじってばかりで、元気が出ない。
items.qr: Saikin, nani o yatte mo shikujitte bakari de, genki ga denai.
items.en: Lately I keep messing up whatever I do, and I can't cheer up.
items.hi: आजकल मैं जो भी करूँ, बस गड़बड़ ही हो जाती है, इसलिए मन उदास रहता है।
items.gu: આજકાલ હું જે કંઈ કરું તેમાં ગડબડ જ થાય છે, તેથી ઉત્સાહ નથી આવતો.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.40). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): しくじる means the same as 失敗する. Other options (added, not in book): 後悔する (regret) is what you might feel after failing, not the failing itself.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞③

items.q: 会社の命令にそむいて、自分だけの判断で行動した。
items.qr: Kaisha no meirei ni somuite, jibun dake no handan de koudou shita.
items.en: I went against the company's orders and acted on my own judgement.
items.hi: मैंने कंपनी के आदेश के ख़िलाफ़ जाकर सिर्फ़ अपने फ़ैसले से काम किया।
items.gu: મેં કંપનીના આદેશની વિરુદ્ધ જઈને ફક્ત મારા પોતાના નિર્ણયથી કામ કર્યું.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.40). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): as the kanji 背く shows, it originally meant "to turn one's back on", and from that it came to mean 裏切る (betray), 反する (go against) and 逆らう (defy). Other options (added, not in book): 断る is refusing a request; it does not take 命令に and does not mean acting against an order.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞③

items.q: 最近、農業にたずさわる人が増えているそうだ。
items.qr: Saikin, nougyou ni tazusawaru hito ga fuete iru sou da.
items.en: I hear more and more people are going into farming these days.
items.hi: सुना है कि आजकल खेती से जुड़ने वाले लोग बढ़ रहे हैं।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે આજકાલ ખેતી સાથે જોડાતા લોકો વધી રહ્યા છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.40). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): besides 関係する and かかわる, 従事する (to be engaged in) is also used with almost the same meaning.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞③

items.q: 田中先生からお祝いの言葉をたまわりたいと存じます。
items.qr: Tanaka-sensei kara oiwai no kotoba o tamawaritai to zonjimasu.
items.en: We would be honoured to receive a few words of congratulation from Professor Tanaka.
items.hi: हम तनाका सर से बधाई के कुछ शब्द (सादर) सुनना चाहेंगे।
items.gu: અમે તનાકા સાહેબ પાસેથી અભિનંદનના થોડા શબ્દો (આદરપૂર્વક) સાંભળવા ઇચ્છીએ છીએ.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.40). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): like いただく, たまわる is the humble form of もらう, but たまわる is used in formal situations.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞③

items.q: インターネットに多くの時間を費やす人はかなり多い。
items.qr: Intaanetto ni ooku no jikan o tsuiyasu hito wa kanari ooi.
items.en: Quite a lot of people spend a great deal of time on the internet.
items.hi: इंटरनेट पर बहुत सारा समय लगाने वाले लोग काफ़ी ज़्यादा हैं।
items.gu: ઇન્ટરનેટ પર ઘણો સમય વિતાવનારા લોકો ઘણા વધારે છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.40). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): read ついやす. It means almost the same as 使う, but is used mainly of money, labour and time, and also carries "keep using until it is gone" — in that sense there is 消費する.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞③

items.q: 看護師の資格を有する方を探しています。
items.qr: Kangoshi no shikaku o yuu suru kata o sagashite imasu.
items.en: We are looking for someone who holds a nursing qualification.
items.hi: हमें नर्स की योग्यता रखने वाले व्यक्ति की तलाश है।
items.gu: અમે નર્સની લાયકાત ધરાવતી વ્યક્તિની શોધમાં છીએ.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.40). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): besides 持っている, 所有する (to own) also has the same meaning. Other options (added, not in book): 目指している would mean the person does not have the qualification yet.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞③

items.q: 付き合っている二人を、周りの人たちがひやかした。
items.qr: Tsukiatte iru futari o, mawari no hitotachi ga hiyakashita.
items.en: The people around them teased the couple who were going out.
items.hi: आसपास के लोगों ने उस प्रेमी जोड़े को छेड़ा।
items.gu: આસપાસના લોકોએ એ પ્રેમી જોડીને ચીડવ્યાં.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.40). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): besides "to tease" (からかう), ひやかす also means asking a shop clerk prices and so on with no intention of buying. Other options (added, not in book): ふざける is intransitive — you fool around yourself; you cannot ふざける someone (二人を).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞③

items.q: 今年は、ホテルでクリスマスパーティーをもよおすそうです。
items.qr: Kotoshi wa, hoteru de kurisumasu paatii o moyoosu sou desu.
items.en: I hear that this year the Christmas party will be held at a hotel.
items.hi: सुना है इस साल क्रिसमस पार्टी होटल में आयोजित की जाएगी।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે આ વર્ષે ક્રિસમસ પાર્ટી હોટેલમાં યોજાશે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.40). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): it is written 催す in kanji, so it means almost the same as 開催する. It also has the meaning "to come into a state, to bring on", as in 吐き気をもよおす (to feel nauseous).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 動詞③

items.q: 面接は、意外とあっさり終わった。
items.qr: Mensetsu wa, igai to assari owatta.
items.en: The interview was over surprisingly quickly and easily.
items.hi: इंटरव्यू उम्मीद से कहीं आसानी से ख़त्म हो गया।
items.gu: ઇન્ટરવ્યૂ ધાર્યા કરતાં સહેલાઈથી પૂરો થઈ ગયો.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.46). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): besides 簡単に, あっさり also means "light and fresh, not rich or heavy" (of a taste). Other options (added, not in book): しつこい is close to the opposite of あっさり (persistent; heavy taste).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 副詞

items.q: ドライブをするときには、あらかじめルートを決めておくとよい。
items.qr: Doraibu o suru toki ni wa, arakajime ruuto o kimete oku to yoi.
items.en: When you go for a drive, it's a good idea to decide your route in advance.
items.hi: ड्राइव पर जाते समय रास्ता पहले से तय कर लेना अच्छा रहता है।
items.gu: ડ્રાઇવ પર જતી વખતે રસ્તો અગાઉથી નક્કી કરી લેવો સારો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.46). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): written 予め in kanji; 予 carries the meaning 前もって, as in 予習 (preparing lessons) and 予報 (forecast).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 副詞

items.q: 試験に出ると予想したら、案の定そうなった。
items.qr: Shiken ni deru to yosou shitara, an no jou sou natta.
items.en: I predicted it would come up in the exam, and sure enough, it did.
items.hi: मैंने अंदाज़ा लगाया था कि यह परीक्षा में आएगा, और जैसा सोचा था वैसा ही हुआ।
items.gu: મેં ધાર્યું હતું કે આ પરીક્ષામાં આવશે, અને ધાર્યા પ્રમાણે જ થયું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.46). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): here 案 means 考え、思ったこと (an idea, what one thought) and 定 means 定まる、決まる (be settled), so 案の定 means 思ったとおり.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 副詞

items.q: あの選手は、引退した後も依然として人気がある。
items.qr: Ano senshu wa, intai shita ato mo izen to shite ninki ga aru.
items.en: That athlete is as popular as ever, even after retiring.
items.hi: वह खिलाड़ी रिटायर होने के बाद भी पहले की तरह ही लोकप्रिय है।
items.gu: તે ખેલાડી નિવૃત્ત થયા પછી પણ પહેલાંની જેમ જ લોકપ્રિય છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.46). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 依然 describes something unchanged from before. The word with the meaning "unchanged from before" is 相変わらず.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 副詞

items.q: この町は、かつて商人の町として栄えた。
items.qr: Kono machi wa, katsute shounin no machi to shite sakaeta.
items.en: This town once flourished as a merchant town.
items.hi: यह शहर कभी व्यापारियों के शहर के रूप में फला-फूला था।
items.gu: આ નગર એક સમયે વેપારીઓના નગર તરીકે સમૃદ્ધ હતું.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.46). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): かつて means almost the same as むかし, 以前 and 前. Other options (added, not in book): もはや also points to time, but to "now, already" (もはや手遅れだ), the opposite direction.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 副詞

items.q: この印刷機は以前のものよりくっきり印刷できます。
items.qr: Kono insatsuki wa izen no mono yori kukkiri insatsu dekimasu.
items.en: This printer can print more sharply than the previous one.
items.hi: यह प्रिंटर पुराने वाले से ज़्यादा साफ़-साफ़ छाप सकता है।
items.gu: આ પ્રિન્ટર જૂના કરતાં વધુ સ્પષ્ટ છાપી શકે છે.

opts.hi: स्पष्ट रूप से, चटकीले ढंग से

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.46). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): besides あざやかに, はっきり has roughly the same meaning. Other options (added, not in book): てっきり shares the -っきり sound but means "I was sure (but wrong)" (てっきり休みだと思った).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 副詞

items.q: 日本語はわかるが、英語はまるっきりわからない。
items.qr: Nihongo wa wakaru ga, eigo wa marukkiri wakaranai.
items.en: I understand Japanese, but I don't understand English at all.
items.hi: मुझे जापानी समझ आती है, लेकिन अंग्रेज़ी बिल्कुल नहीं।
items.gu: મને જાપાનીઝ સમજાય છે, પણ અંગ્રેજી બિલકુલ નહીં.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.46). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): besides 全然, まったく also has the same meaning. Like 全然 and まったく, it is used together with a 〜ない expression. Other options (added, not in book): すっかり (すっかり忘れた) and めっきり (めっきり寒くなった) are used with positive verbs describing a change.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 副詞

items.q: 目下、卒業作品を制作中です。
items.qr: Mokka, sotsugyou sakuhin o seisakuchuu desu.
items.en: I'm currently working on my graduation piece.
items.hi: फ़िलहाल मैं अपना ग्रेजुएशन प्रोजेक्ट बना रहा हूँ।
items.gu: હાલમાં હું મારો ગ્રેજ્યુએશન પ્રોજેક્ટ બનાવી રહ્યો છું.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.46). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): read もっか; it means 今のところ (for now). The word closest to this meaning is 現在. Other options (added, not in book): read めした, 目下 means "one's junior / subordinate" (目上 ⇔ 目下) — that is why 部下 and 上司 are among the options.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 副詞

items.q: あの人は怒るとおっかないから怒らせないほうがいいよ。
items.qr: Ano hito wa okoru to okkanai kara okorasenai hou ga ii yo.
items.en: That person is scary when he gets angry, so you'd better not upset him.
items.hi: वह आदमी ग़ुस्से में डरावना हो जाता है, इसलिए उसे नाराज़ न करना ही अच्छा है।
items.gu: એ માણસ ગુસ્સે થાય ત્યારે ડરામણો બની જાય છે, એટલે તેને ગુસ્સે ન કરવો સારું.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.42). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): besides こわい, おそろしい also has almost the same meaning. Other options (added, not in book): ひどい describes cruel treatment or a bad state, not fear. Option 4 is faint in the scan; read as こい (濃い).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 イ形容詞

items.q: 彼女は、歌手としてはなばなしいデビューを飾った。
items.qr: Kanojo wa, kashu to shite hanabanashii debyuu o kazatta.
items.en: She made a brilliant debut as a singer.
items.hi: उसने गायिका के रूप में शानदार शुरुआत की।
items.gu: તેણે ગાયિકા તરીકે ભવ્ય શરૂઆત કરી.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.42). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): the はな of はなばなしい and the はな of はなやか both mean 花／華 (flower, splendour); both are expressions containing the meaning 見事な、立派な (splendid, fine). Other options (added, not in book): はなはだしい (甚だしい) only sounds similar — it means "extreme", usually about something bad (誤解もはなはだしい). はれやか (晴れやか) is a bright mood or face.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 イ形容詞

items.q: 日本は資源が乏しい国だといわれている。
items.qr: Nihon wa shigen ga toboshii kuni da to iwarete iru.
items.en: Japan is said to be a country poor in natural resources.
items.hi: कहा जाता है कि जापान में प्राकृतिक संसाधन कम हैं।
items.gu: કહેવાય છે કે જાપાનમાં કુદરતી સંસાધનો ઓછાં છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.42). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): besides 少ない, 足りない (not enough) or 不足している (insufficient) are used with almost the same meaning. Other options (added, not in book): 狭い would describe the land (国土が狭い), not 資源.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 イ形容詞

items.q: 外国語学習では、場面にふさわしい表現をたくさん覚えることが重要だ。
items.qr: Gaikokugo gakushuu de wa, bamen ni fusawashii hyougen o takusan oboeru koto ga juuyou da.
items.en: In foreign-language study, it is important to learn lots of expressions that suit each situation.
items.hi: विदेशी भाषा सीखते समय, हर स्थिति के अनुकूल बहुत से वाक्यांश याद करना ज़रूरी है।
items.gu: વિદેશી ભાષા શીખતી વખતે, દરેક પરિસ્થિતિને અનુરૂપ ઘણા વાક્યપ્રયોગો યાદ કરવા જરૂરી છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.42). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): ふさわしい means "matches the situation or atmosphere", so the closest meaning is ぴったりの. Other options (added, not in book): さっぱり, がっちり and あっさり are all ～り words of the same shape as ぴったり, but describe taste, build or manner.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 イ形容詞

items.q: 「ヒマラヤスギ」という木はスギではなくマツの仲間なので、紛らわしい。
items.qr: "Himarayasugi" to iu ki wa sugi de wa naku matsu no nakama na node, magirawashii.
items.en: The tree called "Himalayan cedar" (himaraya-sugi) is not actually a sugi (Japanese cedar) but a member of the pine family, so it is easy to get confused.
items.hi: "हिमालय-सुगी" नाम का पेड़ असल में सुगी नहीं बल्कि चीड़ (पाइन) परिवार का है, इसलिए यह भ्रम पैदा करता है।
items.gu: "હિમાલય-સુગી" નામનું ઝાડ ખરેખર સુગી નહીં પણ પાઇન પરિવારનું છે, તેથી ગૂંચવણ થાય છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.42). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): read まぎらわしい; it means "easy to mistake because things are similar". おぼえにくい is a result of something being まぎらわしい, so it is not right as the answer.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 イ形容詞

items.q: 自分が悪いのにあやまりもせず、言い訳ばかりをするのはとても見苦しい。
items.qr: Jibun ga warui noni ayamari mo sezu, iiwake bakari o suru no wa totemo migurushii.
items.en: When you're the one at fault, making nothing but excuses without even apologising is really disgraceful.
items.hi: अपनी ग़लती होते हुए भी माफ़ी न माँगकर सिर्फ़ बहाने बनाना बहुत शर्मनाक है।
items.gu: પોતાની ભૂલ હોવા છતાં માફી માગ્યા વગર ફક્ત બહાનાં કાઢવાં એ ખૂબ શરમજનક છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.42). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): literally "painful to look at" (見るのが苦しい) — that is, it gives you an unpleasant feeling to watch. So the closest is みっともない. Another word with almost the same meaning is みにくい (醜い, ugly).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 イ形容詞

items.q: 今度の講演会には、世界的に名高い教授が来るそうだ。
items.qr: Kondo no kouenkai ni wa, sekaiteki ni nadakai kyouju ga kuru sou da.
items.en: I hear a world-famous professor is coming to the next lecture.
items.hi: सुना है अगले व्याख्यान में एक विश्व-प्रसिद्ध प्रोफ़ेसर आने वाले हैं।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે આગામી વ્યાખ્યાનમાં એક વિશ્વવિખ્યાત પ્રોફેસર આવવાના છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.42). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 高い has the meaning "widely known in the world", so 有名な means the same. 著名な (chomei na) is also the same. Other options (added, not in book): 1, 3 and 4 each share a kanji (名 or 高) with 名高い but mean something else — a typical shared-kanji trap.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 イ形容詞

items.q: 引っ越しのときには、しなくてはならない手続きがたくさんあり、わずらわしい。
items.qr: Hikkoshi no toki ni wa, shinakute wa naranai tetsuzuki ga takusan ari, wazurawashii.
items.en: When you move house there are so many procedures you have to do — it's a real hassle.
items.hi: घर बदलते समय बहुत सारी कार्यवाहियाँ करनी पड़ती हैं, जो बड़ा झंझट है।
items.gu: ઘર બદલતી વખતે ઘણી બધી કાર્યવાહીઓ કરવી પડે છે, જે ખૂબ ઝંઝટભર્યું છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.42). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): written 煩わしい in kanji. It describes something complicated and bothersome, and is often used of procedures, methods and human relationships. Other options (added, not in book): つまらない (boring) is a different complaint — dull, not troublesome.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 イ形容詞

items.q: この地図は左右があべこべだ。
items.qr: Kono chizu wa sayuu ga abekobe da.
items.en: Left and right on this map are the wrong way round.
items.hi: इस नक़्शे में बायाँ और दायाँ उल्टा है।
items.gu: આ નકશામાં ડાબું અને જમણું ઊલટું છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.44). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): あべこべな is used about order or position.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 ナ形容詞

items.q: かなり昔の映画なので、どんな内容だったかあやふやだ。
items.qr: Kanari mukashi no eiga na node, donna naiyou datta ka ayafuya da.
items.en: It's quite an old film, so I'm hazy about what it was about.
items.hi: यह काफ़ी पुरानी फ़िल्म है, इसलिए उसकी कहानी क्या थी, यह मुझे धुँधला-सा याद है।
items.gu: આ ઘણી જૂની ફિલ્મ છે, એટલે તેની વાર્તા શું હતી તે મને ઝાંખું યાદ છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.44). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): あやふやな expresses that a thought or attitude is not clear; the nearest word is あいまいな. Other options (added, not in book): the tips page (p.8, in its 文脈規定 section) uses exactly this pair, あやふやな and あいまいな, as its example of words with close meanings.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 ナ形容詞

items.q: 「思う」と「考える」の違いを、おおざっぱに説明した。
items.qr: "Omou" to "kangaeru" no chigai o, oozappa ni setsumei shita.
items.en: I explained the difference between 思う and 考える in broad terms.
items.hi: मैंने 思う और 考える का अंतर मोटे तौर पर समझाया।
items.gu: મેં 思う અને 考える વચ્ચેનો તફાવત આશરે (સ્થૂળ રીતે) સમજાવ્યો.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.44). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): おおざっぱ describes grasping the overall picture quickly without considering the details. Unlike おおまかな, it can also be used for personality. Other options (added, not in book): 丁寧に is the opposite idea (with care for detail).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 ナ形容詞

items.q: 財布を忘れて買い物にきた自分自身が、こっけいに思えた。
items.qr: Saifu o wasurete kaimono ni kita jibun jishin ga, kokkei ni omoeta.
items.en: Coming shopping without my wallet, I felt ridiculous.
items.hi: पर्स भूलकर ख़रीदारी करने आए अपने आप पर मुझे हँसी आई।
items.gu: પાકીટ ભૂલીને ખરીદી કરવા આવેલો હું મને પોતાને જ રમુજી લાગ્યો.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.44). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): こっけい describes something so funny it might make you laugh — the same meaning as おかしい in the sense of おもしろい. Other options (added, not in book): くやしい (frustrated) is how you might also feel, but it is not the meaning of こっけい.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 ナ形容詞

items.q: 彼は勤勉で誠実な人です。
items.qr: Kare wa kinben de seijitsu na hito desu.
items.en: He is a hardworking and sincere person.
items.hi: वह मेहनती और ईमानदार इंसान है।
items.gu: તે મહેનતુ અને પ્રામાણિક માણસ છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.44). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 誠実な means almost the same as まじめな. Other options (added, not in book): 熱心 is about eagerness; 誠実 is about honesty and good faith toward people.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 ナ形容詞

items.q: お客様の多様な要望におこたえするために努力いたします。
items.qr: Okyakusama no tayou na youbou ni okotae suru tame ni doryoku itashimasu.
items.en: We will do our best to meet our customers' diverse requests.
items.hi: हम ग्राहकों की तरह-तरह की माँगें पूरी करने की पूरी कोशिश करेंगे।
items.gu: અમે ગ્રાહકોની વિવિધ માંગણીઓ પૂરી કરવા પૂરો પ્રયત્ન કરીશું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.44). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): besides いろいろな, さまざまな also has the same meaning.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 ナ形容詞

items.q: このパソコンは、頻繁に故障する。
items.qr: Kono pasokon wa, hinpan ni koshou suru.
items.en: This computer breaks down all the time.
items.hi: यह कंप्यूटर बार-बार ख़राब हो जाता है।
items.gu: આ કમ્પ્યૂટર વારંવાર બગડી જાય છે.

opts.en: on the spur of the moment

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.44). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): from its meanings "happening many times" and "done without a break", it equals しょっちゅう, which means ずっと、いつも. Other options (added, not in book): めったに is the opposite idea and needs a negative (めったに故障しない).

items.q: 不審な人物を見たら警察に知らせてください。
items.qr: Fushin na jinbutsu o mitara keisatsu ni shirasete kudasai.
items.en: If you see a suspicious person, please tell the police.
items.hi: अगर कोई संदिग्ध व्यक्ति दिखे तो पुलिस को सूचित करें।
items.gu: જો કોઈ શંકાસ્પદ વ્યક્તિ દેખાય તો પોલીસને જાણ કરો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.44). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): 不審 means feeling doubt because there is something unclear. The closest in meaning is あやしい. Other options (added, not in book): the answer is an い-adjective for a な-adjective — the "different part of speech" point from the tips page.

items.q: 問1 欠陥は、即座に解決しなくてはならない。
items.qr: Kekkan wa, sokuza ni kaiketsu shinakute wa naranai.
items.en: The defect must be fixed immediately.
items.hi: इस खराबी (दोष) को तुरंत दूर करना ज़रूरी है।
items.gu: આ ખામી તરત જ દૂર કરવી જરૂરી છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 欠陥
not the reading of 欠陥
not the reading of 欠陥

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 欠 (ケツ) + 陥 (カン): when ケツ is followed by a k-sound it shrinks to a small っ — けっかん. 1 forgets the 促音 (sokuon); 3/4 give 陥 a しょう reading it never has.

items.q: 問1 欠陥は、即座に解決しなくてはならない。
items.qr: Kekkan wa, sokuza ni kaiketsu shinakute wa naranai.
items.en: The defect must be fixed immediately.
items.hi: इस खराबी (दोष) को तुरंत दूर करना ज़रूरी है।
items.gu: આ ખામી તરત જ દૂર કરવી જરૂરી છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 即座に
not the reading of 即座に
not the reading of 即座に

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 即 is ソク (即座・即する), 座 is ザ. すぐに is the meaning, not the reading — a typical trap. ずいじ is 随時 (at any time), せいざ is 正座 (formal kneeling).

items.q: 問2 この苗を栽培するのは難しい。
items.qr: Kono nae o saibai suru no wa muzukashii.
items.en: Growing these seedlings is difficult.
items.hi: इन पौधों (पौध) को उगाना मुश्किल है।
items.gu: આ રોપાઓ ઉછેરવા મુશ્કેલ છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 苗 is read with its kun-yomi なえ (苗を植える). なわ is 縄 (rope), なお is 尚 (still more), なな is 七.

items.q: 問2 この苗を栽培するのは難しい。
items.qr: Kono nae o saibai suru no wa muzukashii.
items.en: Growing these seedlings is difficult.
items.hi: इन पौधों (पौध) को उगाना मुश्किल है।
items.gu: આ રોપાઓ ઉછેરવા મુશ્કેલ છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 栽培
not the reading of 栽培
not the reading of 栽培

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 栽 = サイ, 培 = バイ (栽培農家). さいばん is 裁判 (trial) — 栽 and 裁 look alike, so do not let the shared part pull you toward the wrong word. 培 is never ブ.

items.q: 問3 相手は依然として譲歩しないと言っている。
items.qr: Aite wa izen to shite jouho shinai to itte iru.
items.en: The other side says it still will not make any concession.
items.hi: सामने वाला पक्ष कहता है कि वह अब भी कोई रियायत (समझौता) नहीं करेगा।
items.gu: સામેનો પક્ષ કહે છે કે તે હજી પણ કોઈ બાંધછોડ નહીં કરે.

opts.en: not the reading of 依然
not the reading of 依然
not the reading of 依然
still, as before (依然として = still, as ever)

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 依 is イ (依頼・依存). エ is a rare Buddhist reading (帰依 きえ) and never applies here. Note いぜん is also 以前 (before) — same sound, different word.

items.q: 問3 相手は依然として譲歩しないと言っている。
items.qr: Aite wa izen to shite jouho shinai to itte iru.
items.en: The other side says it still will not make any concession.
items.hi: सामने वाला पक्ष कहता है कि वह अब भी कोई रियायत (समझौता) नहीं करेगा।
items.gu: સામેનો પક્ષ કહે છે કે તે હજી પણ કોઈ બાંધછોડ નહીં કરે.

opts.en: not the reading of 譲歩
not the reading of 譲歩
not the reading of 譲歩

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 譲 is ジョウ (voiced, long vowel) and 歩 here is ホ (歩 has ホ／ボ／ブ). じょうぶ is 丈夫 (sturdy) and しょうぶ is 勝負 (match) — real words, so they look tempting.

items.q: 問4 新しい横綱は、前進するときの威力がかなりある。
items.qr: Atarashii yokozuna wa, zenshin suru toki no iryoku ga kanari aru.
items.en: The new yokozuna (sumo grand champion) has tremendous power when he pushes forward.
items.hi: नए योकोज़ुना (सूमो के सर्वोच्च चैंपियन) में आगे धकेलते समय ज़बरदस्त ताक़त है।
items.gu: નવા યોકોઝુના (સુમોના સર્વોચ્ચ ચેમ્પિયન)માં આગળ ધકેલતી વખતે જબરદસ્ત તાકાત છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 横綱
not the reading of 横綱
not the reading of 横綱

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): An all-kun-yomi word: 横 よこ + 綱 つな → voiced to づな (連濁, rendaku). おう〜 tries an on-yomi (横 = オウ); あみ is 網 (net), which looks like 綱.

items.q: 問4 新しい横綱は、前進するときの威力がかなりある。
items.qr: Atarashii yokozuna wa, zenshin suru toki no iryoku ga kanari aru.
items.en: The new yokozuna (sumo grand champion) has tremendous power when he pushes forward.
items.hi: नए योकोज़ुना (सूमो के सर्वोच्च चैंपियन) में आगे धकेलते समय ज़बरदस्त ताक़त है।
items.gu: નવા યોકોઝુના (સુમોના સર્વોચ્ચ ચેમ્પિયન)માં આગળ ધકેલતી વખતે જબરદસ્ત તાકાત છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 威力
not the reading of 威力
not the reading of 威力

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 威 = イ (権威・威張る); 力 here = リョク (as in 能力・努力). リキ appears in 力士 りきし / 自力 じりき, so 2 is a near miss. 威 is never えい.

items.q: 問5 腸の手術の経過は良好です。
items.qr: Chou no shujutsu no keika wa ryoukou desu.
items.en: Recovery after the intestinal surgery is going well.
items.hi: आंत के ऑपरेशन के बाद की स्थिति अच्छी है।
items.gu: આંતરડાના ઓપરેશન પછીની સ્થિતિ સારી છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 腸 is チョウ (大腸・胃腸). The right side 昜 also appears in 場 (ジョウ), 湯 (トウ), 陽 (ヨウ) — exactly the "shared part" trap the tips page warns about.

items.q: 問5 腸の手術の経過は良好です。
items.qr: Chou no shujutsu no keika wa ryoukou desu.
items.en: Recovery after the intestinal surgery is going well.
items.hi: आंत के ऑपरेशन के बाद की स्थिति अच्छी है।
items.gu: આંતરડાના ઓપરેશન પછીની સ્થિતિ સારી છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 良好
not the reading of 良好
not the reading of 良好

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 良 = リョウ (拗音 ryo, not yo) and 好 = コウ (long vowel, as in 友好・格好). 2 and 4 drop the long vowel of コウ.

items.q: 問6 不正乗車をした場合は、3倍の運賃を請求いたします。
items.qr: Fusei jousha o shita baai wa, sanbai no unchin o seikyuu itashimasu.
items.en: If you ride without a valid ticket, we will charge three times the fare.
items.hi: बिना सही टिकट यात्रा करने पर तीन गुना किराया वसूला जाएगा।
items.gu: માન્ય ટિકિટ વગર મુસાફરી કરવા પર ત્રણ ગણું ભાડું વસૂલવામાં આવશે.

opts.en: not the reading of 運賃
not the reading of 運賃
not the reading of 運賃

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 賃 = チン (賃金・家賃). 賃 is not ニン (that is 任) and not キン (that is 金).

items.q: 問6 不正乗車をした場合は、3倍の運賃を請求いたします。
items.qr: Fusei jousha o shita baai wa, sanbai no unchin o seikyuu itashimasu.
items.en: If you ride without a valid ticket, we will charge three times the fare.
items.hi: बिना सही टिकट यात्रा करने पर तीन गुना किराया वसूला जाएगा।
items.gu: માન્ય ટિકિટ વગર મુસાફરી કરવા પર ત્રણ ગણું ભાડું વસૂલવામાં આવશે.

opts.en: not the reading of 請求
not the reading of 請求
not the reading of 請求

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.10). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 請 = セイ (要請・申請) and 求 = キュウ (要求). そきゅう is 遡及 (retroactive) — a real word, so it is the strongest distractor.

items.q: 問1 台風による災害の規模は、昔と比べると小さくなったが、それでも台風は恐ろしいものだ。
items.qr: Taifuu ni yoru saigai no kibo wa, mukashi to kuraberu to chiisaku natta ga, soredemo taifuu wa osoroshii mono da.
items.en: The scale of typhoon damage has become smaller than in the past, but typhoons are still frightening.
items.hi: तूफ़ान से होने वाली आपदा का पैमाना पहले की तुलना में छोटा हो गया है, फिर भी तूफ़ान डरावने ही हैं।
items.gu: વાવાઝોડાથી થતી આપત્તિનો વ્યાપ પહેલાંની સરખામણીએ ઘટ્યો છે, છતાં વાવાઝોડાં ડરામણાં જ છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 災害
not the reading of 災害
not the reading of 災害

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.12). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 災 = サイ (天災), 害 = ガイ. ひがい is 被害 (damage suffered) and かがい is 加害 (inflicting harm) — real words with the same 害, so they tempt you. 災 contains 火 (fire), but it is not カ.

items.en: The scale of typhoon damage has become smaller than in the past, but typhoons are still frightening.
items.hi: तूफ़ान से होने वाली आपदा का पैमाना पहले की तुलना में छोटा हो गया है, फिर भी तूफ़ान डरावने ही हैं।
items.gu: વાવાઝોડાથી થતી આપત્તિનો વ્યાપ પહેલાંની સરખામણીએ ઘટ્યો છે, છતાં વાવાઝોડાં ડરામણાં જ છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 規模
not the reading of 規模
not the reading of 規模

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.12). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 模 has two on-yomi — モ (模型・模様) and ボ, which is used in 規模. Option 2 picks the more common モ, the "several readings" trap. 規 = キ (規則), never きゅ.

items.q: 問2 大統領は、両国の合意を根底から覆す発言をした。
items.qr: Daitouryou wa, ryoukoku no goui o kontei kara kutsugaesu hatsugen o shita.
items.en: The president made a remark that overturned the two countries' agreement from its very foundation.
items.hi: राष्ट्रपति ने ऐसा बयान दिया जिसने दोनों देशों के समझौते को जड़ से पलट दिया।
items.gu: રાષ્ટ્રપતિએ એવું નિવેદન કર્યું જેણે બંને દેશોના કરારને મૂળમાંથી ઉથલાવી દીધો.

opts.en: not the reading of 根底
not the reading of 根底
not the reading of 根底

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, p.12). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): An on-yomi compound: 根 コン + 底 テイ (海底 かいてい). こんぽん is 根本 (root, basis) and ねもと is 根元 (base of a tree) — both real words with 根 and a similar meaning. ねそこ mixes kun-yomi ね + そこ (底).

opts.en: not the reading of 覆す
not the reading of 覆す
not the reading of 覆す

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.12). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 覆 has two kun-yomi: おお・う (覆う, to cover) and くつがえ・す (覆す, to overturn). The okurigana tells you which: 〜う → おおう, 〜す → くつがえす. おおす is a blend of the two. ゆらす is 揺らす (to shake), まかす is 負かす (to defeat).

items.q: 問3 反対派は、裁判所に訴訟を起こした。
items.qr: Hantaiha wa, saibansho ni soshou o okoshita.
items.en: The opposition group filed a lawsuit with the court.
items.hi: विरोधी पक्ष ने अदालत में मुक़दमा दायर किया।
items.gu: વિરોધી પક્ષે અદાલતમાં મુકદ્દમો દાખલ કર્યો.

opts.en: not the reading of 裁判
not the reading of 裁判
not the reading of 裁判

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, p.12). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): A pure 濁点 (dakuten) test: 裁 = サイ (unvoiced), 判 = バン here (判断 はんだん has ハン, but 裁判・評判 have バン). さいはん is 再版/再犯 — a different word.

items.q: 問3 反対派は、裁判所に訴訟を起こした。
items.qr: Hantaiha wa, saibansho ni soshou o okoshita.
items.en: The opposition group filed a lawsuit with the court.
items.hi: विरोधी पक्ष ने अदालत में मुक़दमा दायर किया।
items.gu: વિરોધી પક્ષે અદાલતમાં મુકદ્દમો દાખલ કર્યો.

opts.en: not the reading of 訴訟
not the reading of 訴訟
not the reading of 訴訟

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, p.12). Why (added, not in book — the key gives numbers only): 訴 = ソ (訴える うったえる), 訟 = ショウ — the right side 公 (コウ) is misleading, but 訟 is ショウ. 4 swaps the two sounds; 3 is せっしょう (殺生/折衝), another word.

items.q: 問4 川の堤防を新しくすることが決まった。完成が待ち遠しい。
items.qr: Kawa no teibou o atarashiku suru koto ga kimatta. Kansei ga machidooshii.
items.en: It has been decided to rebuild the river embankment. I can hardly wait for it to be finished.
items.hi: नदी का तटबंध नया बनाने का फ़ैसला हुआ है। उसके पूरा होने का बेसब्री से इंतज़ार है।
items.gu: નદીનો પાળો નવો બનાવવાનું નક્કી થયું છે. તે પૂરો થાય તેની આતુરતાથી રાહ છે.

opts.en: not the reading of 堤防

opts.t: ほこったじゃがいもをつぶして、しょうゆとバターをつけて食べます。
opts.r: Hokotta jagaimo o tsubushite, shouyu to bataa o tsukete tabemasu.
opts.en: ✗ Means "mash steamed potatoes and eat them with soy sauce and butter" — needs ふかした (fukashita).
opts.hi: ✗ अर्थ: "उबले/भाप में पके आलू मसलकर…" — यहाँ ふかした चाहिए।
opts.gu: ✗ અર્થ: "બાફેલા બટાકા છૂંદીને…" — અહીં ふかした જોઈએ.

opts.t: 完ぺきな彼にも少しずつ欠点がほこり始めた。
opts.r: Kanpeki na kare ni mo sukoshi zutsu ketten ga hokori hajimeta.
opts.en: ✗ Means "flaws began to show even in perfect him" — needs 見え (mie) or ほころび (hokorobi, to come apart).
opts.hi: ✗ अर्थ: "उसकी कमियाँ दिखने लगीं" — 見え या ほころび चाहिए।
opts.gu: ✗ અર્થ: "તેની ખામીઓ દેખાવા લાગી" — 見え કે ほころび જોઈએ.

opts.t: 部屋を掃除しないと、すぐにほこってしまう。
opts.r: Heya o souji shinai to, sugu ni hokotte shimau.
opts.en: ✗ Means "the room soon gets dusty" — needs ほこりがたまって (hokori ga tamatte); ほこり "dust" is a noun, not this verb.
opts.hi: ✗ अर्थ: "कमरे में जल्दी धूल जम जाती है" — ほこりがたまって चाहिए।
opts.gu: ✗ અર્થ: "રૂમમાં જલદી ધૂળ જામી જાય છે" — ほこりがたまって જોઈએ.

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, p.48). Book's 解説 (paraphrased): ほこる expresses that someone or something has strength or force (here: real ability as the top seller). Why the others are wrong (added, not in book): 2 and 4 play on sound: ほこり (埃, dust) is a noun that looks like the verb's stem; 3 confuses it with ほころびる (綻びる, a seam coming apart → flaws showing). ほこる always takes something good as its object: 実力・
